This is a list of '''[[Member of the Order of the British Empire|MBE]]s''' awarded in the '''[[1946 New Year Honours]]'''

The '''1946 New Year Honours''' were appointments by many of the [[Commonwealth Realms]] of King [[George VI]] to [[Orders and decorations of the Commonwealth realms|various orders and honours]] to reward and highlight good works by citizens of those countries, and to celebrate the passing of 1945 and the beginning of 1946. They were announced on 1 January 1946 for the United Kingdom,<ref>United Kingdom list (1): {{London Gazette |date=28 December 1945 |issue=37407 |pages=1–132  |nolink=yes}}</ref><ref>United Kingdom list (2): {{London Gazette |date=28 December 1945 |supp=y |issue=37412 |pages=275–338  |nolink=yes}}</ref> and Dominions,<ref>Dominions list: {{London Gazette |date=28 December 1945 |supp=y |issue=37411 |pages=167–168  |nolink=yes}}</ref> [[1946 New Years Honours (Canada)|Canada]],<ref>Canada list: {{London Gazette |date=28 December 1945 |supp=y |issue=37408 |pages=133–152  |nolink=yes}}</ref> the [[1946 New Years Honours (South Africa)|Union of South Africa]],<ref>Union of South Africa list: {{London Gazette |date=28 December 1945 |supp=y |issue=37409 |pages=153–156  |nolink=yes}}</ref> and [[1946 New Years Honours (New Zealand)|New Zealand]].<ref>New Zealand list: {{London Gazette |date=28 December 1945 |supp=y |issue=37410 |pages=157–165  |nolink=yes}}</ref>

This is a list of MBEs awarded in the 1946 New Year Honours
The 1946 New Year Honours were appointments by many of the Commonwealth Realms of King George VI to various orders and honours to reward and highlight good works by citizens of those countries, and to celebrate the passing of 1945 and the beginning of 1946. They were announced on 1 January 1946 for the United Kingdom, and Dominions, Canada, the Union of South Africa, and New Zealand.
